text: Finished the quilt I've been working on for a year. Every stitch by hand. I did that.
Wrapped up in the new quilt Gran sent, rain outside, tea in hand. Lovely evening.
Got the promotion I've been working towards for three years. I earned this one.
Office party tonight, everyone in silly hats, cake for days. Such a fun evening.
Taught myself to change the car's oil from videos. Did it right first time. Look at me.
Sunny drive to the coast with the windows down and our favourite songs on. Perfect day.
My son read his poem at assembly and didn't stumble once. I worked on it with him every night for a week.
My son made me laugh so hard at dinner I had to leave the table. What a silly, lovely kid.
Held my ground in the negotiation and got a fair price. Old me would have folded.
Found a vintage lamp at the market for three pounds. Love it. Little joys.
Hit my savings goal for the year two months early. All those packed lunches paid off.
Lazy brunch with Kemi, pancakes and gossip. Felt light all afternoon.
Passed the bar exam on my second attempt. I didn't give up.
Puppy fell asleep on my lap during the film. Couldn't stop smiling.
I said no to the extra project and explained why, calmly. Holding a boundary felt like an achievement.
Weekend off, no plans, sunshine. Wandered the park eating an ice cream. Delightful.
Built the website for the charity myself, from nothing. It went live today and it works.
Danced around the kitchen to the radio with the kids. Everyone laughing.
Ran my first 5k without walking. Six months ago I couldn't run to the bus stop.
Beautiful morning run by the river, mist on the water, ducks everywhere. What a start to the day.
My students all passed the exam. Every single one. I pushed them hard and they rose to it.
Students threw me a surprise party for my birthday. Balloons, terrible singing, a card from all of them.
Spoke up about the unfair rota in the staff meeting, and they changed it. I made that happen.
Good chat with the team over lunch, lots of laughing. Nice day at work for once.
Learned the whole piano piece by heart. Played it for Mum without a single mistake.
Mum played her old records and we sang along badly all evening. Such a happy night.
Paid off the car loan. Eighteen months of being careful and it's done.
Picnic in the garden with Leo, strawberries and lemonade. Simple and lovely.
Two years sober today. I fought for every one of those days.
Fireworks over the bay tonight. We all oohed like children. Magic.
Fixed the leaking pipe myself instead of calling someone. Took two hours and a lot of swearing, but it's fixed.
New coffee shop round the corner and the barista remembered my order. Little things make my day.
I finally finished my degree at forty-three, working nights the whole way through.
Graduation party for my niece. Music, food, dancing. Great fun.
Gave my first talk at a conference and people came up afterwards to ask questions. I did a good job.
Conference trip was a blast. Met lovely people, ate great food, laughed a lot.
Kept my temper all week with the difficult customer. Stayed professional every time. Quietly chuffed with myself.
Sun's out, it's Friday, the shop was quiet and I'm going to the pub. Happy days.
Rescued the dying plant from the office bin and nursed it back. It's flowering now. My doing.
The plant on my desk flowered today. Bright pink. Made me smile all morning.
Long day, nothing dramatic, just tired. Heavy eyes, early bed.
Ten things due today, four people waiting on me, phone won't stop. I can't keep up.
Slept badly so I've been yawning all day. Calm enough, just sleepy.
Slept badly because my head was spinning with everything I have to sort out this week. It's too much at once.
Hiked fifteen miles. Legs done, body done. Good tired.
Wedding planning, work deadline and the house move all in the same fortnight. I don't know where to start.
Night shift again. Body's running on fumes but work was steady.
Night shift chaos. Three emergencies at once, everyone needing me, no time to think.
Drained after the long drive. Just want my bed.
Too many choices, too many forms, too many calls about Dad's care. My head is full and I can't think.
Newborn kept us up again. Sleepy, slow, but okay.
Baby screaming, toddler sick, partner away, dishes piled up. Everything at once and I'm drowning.
Low energy today. Did the basics and rested.
So many tabs open in my head I couldn't finish a single task. Started five, finished none.
Played football all afternoon. Exhausted in the best way.
Coaching the team, running the club accounts and organising the tournament. Too many hats. I'm stretched thin.
Jet lag. Can't keep my eyes open after lunch.
Back from the trip to 300 emails, a broken boiler and a sick cat. I just sat on my suitcase.
Tired after a full day of gardening. Back aching, but nothing to worry about.
The garden, the house repairs, Mum's appointments, the kids' clubs. I can't hold all of it at once.
Just worn out. Nothing wrong. Need sleep.
Everything is piling up faster than I can clear it.
Ran the stall at the fair all day. Feet ache. Happy, but shattered.
Running the stall, the kids got lost, the card machine died and it started raining. Everything went wrong at once.
Sleepy after the big lunch. Napped on the sofa.
Big family lunch: twelve people, three dietary needs, one oven. I panicked in the kitchen.
Studied until midnight. Brain's foggy. Bed.
Four exams, two essays and a part-time job this week. I keep rewriting my to-do list instead of doing it.
Body still recovering from the flu. Slept most of the day.
Off sick, and every hour the inbox grows. Work, school forms, bills. I can't face any of it.
Weary today. Eyes heavy, steps slow.
Head spinning from all the decisions.
Long week. Ready for the weekend and a lie-in.
Long week where everything landed at once. I don't know which fire to put out first.
Painted the whole fence. Arms like jelly. Done for the day.
The builders need answers on tiles, taps, lights and doors by tomorrow. I can't decide anything.
Up at five for the early flight. Dozing at the gate.
Missed flight, lost bag, hotel cancelled, kids crying. Too much to deal with at once.
Tired after the move but the boxes are in. Will unpack slowly.
Moving day: boxes everywhere, keys missing, landlord calling, van late. I just stood in the hallway frozen.
